components.name: Destination Icon
components.description: An accessible icon-only destination with a three-rem square target.
components.css: .ds-destination-icon { display: grid; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgb(192 202 245 / 12%); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--surface, #1f2335); box-shadow: 0 0.35rem 0.75rem rgb(10 12 20 / 30%), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(226 229 242 / 13%), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(10 12 20 / 45%); color: var(--ink-soft, #a9b1d6); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-destination-icon svg { width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; fill: currentColor; } .ds-destination-icon:hover { box-shadow: 0 0.6rem 1.1rem rgb(10 12 20 / 42%), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(226 229 242 / 18%); color: var(--accent-active, #7dcfff); transform: translateY(-0.15rem); } .ds-destination-icon:active { box-shadow: inset 0 0.2rem 0.35rem rgb(10 12 20 / 45%); transform: translateY(0.08rem) scale(0.97); } .ds-destination-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 0.3rem; }

components.name: Square Portrait
components.description: The sole photographic object with a strict square silhouette.
components.css: .ds-portrait { width: 15rem; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(192 202 245 / 12%); border-radius: 1rem; aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--surface, #1f2335); box-shadow: 0 1.25rem 2.5rem rgb(10 12 20 / 42%), 0 0.35rem 0.8rem rgb(10 12 20 / 30%), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(226 229 242 / 13%), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(10 12 20 / 45%); } .ds-portrait div { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--particle-line, #565f89); }

narrative.overview: Centered Signal treats a personal profile as one calm identity instrument rather than a collection of cards or sections. The name leads a compact centered block, with the bilingual greeting and role sharing one metadata line above one truthful square portrait and four icon-only destinations. The atmosphere is dark, human, and technical without becoming terminal-themed or ornamental.
keyCharacteristics: A centered vertical composition with broad negative space.
One photographic subject and no decorative stock imagery.
A flat Tokyo Night ground with restrained raised portrait and button surfaces.
Four authored icon destinations with accessible names and generous targets.
Sparse motion that remains subordinate to identity and navigation.

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue and cyan identify emphasis or interaction; they never become broad decorative fills.

rules.name: The Identity Block Rule
rules.body: The name leads while the greeting and role share one supporting line, keeping all three items in one visual and semantic group without an eyebrow label.

rules.name: The Center Line Rule
rules.body: The identity, portrait, and destinations share the same horizontal center at every supported width.

rules.name: The Material Restraint Rule
rules.body: Only the portrait and icon buttons receive elevation; text and page structure remain flat.

dos: Do lead with the name and keep the greeting and role together on one supporting line.
Do give every icon-only destination an accessible name and at least a 44px target.
Do preserve the uniform Tokyo Night field and broad negative space.
donts: Don't add cards, pills, badges, gradients, glass effects, glow, or heavy shadows.
Don't add visible labels to the destination row unless the product direction changes.
Don't add stock photography, decorative video, professional claims, or metrics without real evidence.
Don't let canvas interaction intercept semantic content or navigation.
